feedback.retry: Review Place funnel and try again.

nodes.description: Seat the filter paper flat in the funnel.

feedback.retry: Review Seat filter paper and try again.

nodes.title: Attach receiver
nodes.description: Attach the side-arm receiver beneath the funnel.

feedback.retry: Review Attach receiver and try again.

nodes.title: Place vacuum source
nodes.description: Place the vacuum source beside the filter flask.

feedback.retry: Review Place vacuum source and try again.

nodes.title: Wet filter paper

feedback.retry: Review Wet filter paper and try again.

feedback.retry: Review Filter suspension and try again.

feedback.retry: Review Read watch-glass tare and try again.

nodes.description: Copy the watch-glass mass into the notebook.

feedback.retry: Review Record watch-glass tare and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer collected solid
nodes.description: Move the filter paper and precipitate to the tared watch glass.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer collected solid and try again.

nodes.description: Dry the assembly for the teacher-configured 10-15 minute stage.

feedback.retry: Review First drying stage and try again.

nodes.title: Break precipitate
nodes.description: Break the partly dried precipitate into small pieces.

feedback.retry: Review Break precipitate and try again.

nodes.description: Return the assembly to the oven for five minutes.

feedback.retry: Review Second drying stage and try again.

feedback.retry: Review Record combined mass and try again.

nodes.description: Calculate collected precipitate mass by difference.
